skillTree.localised_description: Furtive, scheming, sly, cunning, underhand, devious, conniving, double-dealing, and sneaky - valuable traits if you wish to stay alive!
All Skaven are unprincipled and untrustworthy by their foul natures. However, this is rarely a disadvantage in the face of the enemy.
The Warriors of Chaos are the playthings of Gods and given many gifts, including formidable fighting skills.

skillTree.localised_description: A violent upbringing is nothing unusual for those denizens of the Chaos Wastes who survive into adulthood. To bear it all with a silent smirk, however, is.
Every dark army requires a particularly twisted mind, capable of thinking three steps ahead of the enemy.

effects.description: Training action: Unit experience gain is increased by an additional 20%

skillTree.localised_description: Those whom Slaanesh favours with His mark are gifted with extraordinary senses, and not just the usual five. Weak-willed and the hesitant foes draw them almost irresistibly.

ui_effects.localised_text: Effect intensity increases by each enemy unit in range with leadership wavering or lower.

skillTree.localised_description: Avoiding an arrow or strikes from the rear is no match for this seasoned and battle-hardened warrior.

related_attributes.bullet_text: This unit takes no penalties when flanked.

skillTree.localised_description: Standing face to face with your enemy means getting to watch the light fade from their eyes when you win.
Among the most insidious of Slaanesh's gifts renders the enemy unwilling to hurt His favoured devotees, and even willing to praise them.
So much of war is an art. Over time and with much practice, combat moves can resemble a series of perfectly-rehearsed dance moves.
This being fights dirty, no honour system applies here!
"Stay in one place, gods-damn you!"
Whether a targeted slice to the throat, or a precision stab to the heart, this one knows how to kill!
The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.
From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.
Those who are fleet of foot can reach the enemy faster.
Always on the lookout for an opening or advantage in battle - somewhere to put the knife in…
The harder they hit, the more they commit, the easier it is to strike back.
A blade that sings in defence will not let its wielder be penetrated.
The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.
Given only to his most trusted and devoted followers, enhancing their vigour to new hights and forever binding them to the path of excess.
A gift from the dark gods, a armour only fit for the mightiest Warlords and honoured Chieftains.
Receive the mark of Slaanesh and ascend into daemonhood.
